page: Google Cloud Platform n2d-highcpu-16 is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an AMD EPYC 7B13 processor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 8 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The system is configured with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a low memory-to-core ratio of 1.0 GB per vCPU. No local storage or GPUs are bundled with this instance type.

In benchmark evaluations, the server demonstrates strong single-core CPU performance, placing in the top 25% of tested instances via stress-ng single-core tests. Multi-core performance, memory bandwidth, and compression tasks fall within the average range. Specifically, the instance achieves a Geekbench single-core score of 1476.0 and a multi-core score of 9379.0, alongside a static web serving throughput of 15.62 GB/sec.

The primary tradeoff of the n2d-highcpu-16 is its constrained memory allocation relative to its compute capacity, which limits its utility for memory-intensive databases or large-scale data caching. However, the dedicated AMD EPYC cores provide stable compute performance for CPU-bound tasks. This profile is suitable for workloads such as software compilation, web serving, text processing, and lightweight machine learning inference.
